data.description:
## Problem statement

The player ship's thrust flame keeps its current animated length when the pressed direction keys change (e.g. switching from Up to Left, or adding/removing a direction key mid-thrust). The flame simply re-orients to the new direction while keeping its length (see the 'flame's direction changed while a flame is visible' redraw branch in src/entities/Player.ts::preUpdate). The producer wants each change of the pressed keys to start a fresh flame burst from length 0.

## Desired change

When the set of pressed direction keys (up/down/left/right) changes while thrusting, the animated flame length must reset to 0 and regrow from there in the new direction, at the normal growth rate (proportional to thrustAcceleration).

- Pressed-key change (any direction-key state change) while a direction is held → flame length resets to 0 immediately on that frame.
- The flame then grows from 0 toward shipSize × thrustFlameLength at the existing rate (time-to-full = 0.03 s × (300 / thrustAcceleration) at reference thrust).
- Releasing all keys keeps existing decay semantics (decay at 4× growth rate; length never below 0) — no stuck flame.
- Unchanged held keys must NOT reset the flame (normal growth/decay continue).
- Existing feel tuning (FLAME_GROWTH_TIME_AT_REF = 0.03 s), framerate independence (delta-time based), and config-live max length are unchanged.

discovered-from:AH-0MTAF5YLT009TXAM

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: Changing the pressed keys while thrusting resets the observable flame length (getFlameLength()) to 0 on that frame.
- AC2: The flame regrows from 0 in the new direction at the normal growth rate (higher thrustAcceleration → reaches full faster).
- AC3: Releasing all keys still decays the flame (4× growth rate) to 0 — no stuck flame on release.
- AC4: Holding the same keys does not reset the length — the flame continues growing/decaying normally frame to frame.
- AC5: Full test suite and tsc build remain green; docs (Player.ts header, GDD §2.2) updated to describe the reset-on-key-change behavior.
data.title: Reset thrust flame length to 0 when the pressed keys change
